task: Research and compose a step-by-step guide for applying for a Japan tourist visa: eligibility, required documents, application process, fees, and processing time.

dataModel.title: Japan Tourist Visa Application Guide
dataModel.goal: Research and compose a step-by-step guide for applying for a Japan tourist visa: eligibility, required documents, application process, fees, and processing time.
dataModel.summary: A comprehensive guide for foreign nationals applying for a short-term stay tourist visa for Japan.

table_rows.Details: Varies by nationality and local currency
Usually not required, but may be requested

dataModel.intro: A comprehensive guide for foreign nationals applying for a short-term stay tourist visa for Japan.
dataModel.section_0_points:
• Must be a foreign national requiring a visa for entry.
• Purpose of visit must be strictly tourism, sightseeing, or visiting friends/relatives.
• Must possess a valid passport with at least two blank pages.
• Must demonstrate sufficient financial means to cover travel expenses.
dataModel.section_1_points:
• Valid passport (original and photocopy).
• Completed visa application form with a recent passport-sized photo.
• Proof of financial capacity (e.g., bank statements, income tax returns).
• Detailed itinerary of stay in Japan.
• Confirmed flight reservation or booking details.
• Proof of accommodation (hotel bookings or invitation letter).
dataModel.section_2_points:
• Check the jurisdiction of the nearest Japanese Embassy or Consulate.
• Prepare all required documents according to the specific embassy checklist.
• Submit application in person or via an authorized travel agency.
• Pay the visa fee upon submission or collection.
• Collect passport once notified of the visa decision.
